attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Indiana state income tax calculation. Implements flat 3.05% tax structure per IN tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi 0.0305 mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Indiana tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Indiana military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Extended to Space Force, USPHS, and NOAA Corps in 2025. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per IC 6-3-2-3.7 (2025).

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Indiana military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "Indiana Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.in_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.in_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.in_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.in_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.in_military_retirement_exclusion result.in_sbp_exclusion add /result.in_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.in_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.in_adjusted_agi xdef
"Indiana military retirement exclusion: $" result.in_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.in_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Indiana SBP exclusion: $" result.in_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Indiana total military exclusion: $" result.in_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
